panels.description:
Write Amplification = physically_written_rows / committed_rows.

QuestDB stores rows ordered by designated timestamp. When data arrives out-of-order, the engine must rewrite existing partition data to keep it sorted, causing it to physically write more rows than were committed.

- ~1.0  ideal (mostly in-order ingestion)
- 2-5  moderate amplification, acceptable
- >10  high amplification — investigate o3MaxLag / commit lag tuning, or check ingestion ordering.

Reference: https://questdb.com/docs/getting-started/capacity-planning/#write-amplification
panels.title: QuestDB Write Amplification

panels.description: Write Amplification ratio over time. Sustained values >5 typically indicate out-of-order data arriving outside the o3MaxLag window, forcing partition rewrites. See https://questdb.com/docs/getting-started/capacity-planning/#write-amplification
